title: TutorLink - Student-Tutor Platform
description: A full-stack platform to connect students with qualified tutors. Includes profiles, bookings, and payment integration.
challenges: Managing state between booking and calendar
Making it responsive for all devices

title: Book store
description: A full-stack e-commerce platform where users can browse and buy books with integrated payment functionality. Admins have access to a powerful dashboard to perform CRUD operations on books, users, and orders, including changing order statuses and managing user activation.
learned: Backend development with Node.js and Express
challenges: Making the application fully responsive across devices
Building a robust admin dashboard to add/delete books and manage users
Implementing logic to activate/deactivate users efficiently
Handling order management and updating order statuses
